The pre-emptee Nos.1-5 contested the case by filing a written objection denying the material allegations made in the miscellaneous application and further contended that the case is barred under section 96(10) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Their further case is that the land of C.S.Khatian No.268 of Monza and Police Station Birol, District-Dinajpur belonged to Pamir Mohammad, the grandfather of the pre-emptee Nos.1-5 and others. The preemptee Nos.I-5 are co-sharers tenants to the said C.S. Khatian No.268. The S.A. Khatian was not recorded in the name of father of the pre-emptees through oversight. The co-sharership .of the pre-emptee remains unaffected since they are also co-sharers by inheritance. So, the case is liable to fail 

 6. It is not disputed that the pre-emptor and pre-emptee Nos.I-5 are co-sharers by inheritance in the disputed holding. Since the original jama of the C.S. Khatian remained intact, the pre-emption case hit by section 96(10) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act as both parties are co-sharers by inheritance.
